# Boardroom CXO

> Executive search firm for retail, jewelry and D2C brands in India and the UAE. Places marketing, sales and retail, business development, finance, HR and operations leaders, headhunted from competitor companies and benchmarked on real (not CTC-slip) pay data, rather than sourced from job-board databases.

Boardroom CXO is based in Surat, India, and serves clients across India and the UAE. Retail is the umbrella; jewelry and D2C brands are the deepest specialism. The firm's differentiators: direct headhunting of passive candidates who are not job-hunting, market-mapping compensation before a mandate is priced, and verifying actual take-home pay (bank credit) rather than reported CTC, a known gap at legacy retail and jewelry brands. Boardroom CXO also publishes two leadership series on LinkedIn and this site: Inside the Boardroom (long-form profiles of Indian business leaders) and Boardroom Moves (senior leadership-move announcements).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://boardroomcxo.com/): positioning, roles filled, a live compensation-benchmarking tool by role, store count and city tier, and a static 2025-26 pay table
- [About Us](https://boardroomcxo.com/about-us): firm history, founder CA Ketul Patel, placement track record and team
- [Case Studies](https://boardroomcxo.com/case-studies): real placement outcomes, including CMO, CFO, sales and operations leadership hires
- [Resources](https://boardroomcxo.com/resources): field articles on executive hiring, compensation and leadership
- [Get Featured](https://boardroomcxo.com/get-featured): submit a leadership move for Boardroom Moves or pitch a story for Inside the Boardroom
- [Schedule a Call](https://boardroomcxo.com/schedule-a-call): contact and booking

## Hiring by function

- [Marketing and CMO search](https://boardroomcxo.com/marketing-leadership-hiring): CMOs, CGOs, performance marketing leads and brand leaders for retail, jewelry and D2C brands
- [Sales and retail leadership search](https://boardroomcxo.com/sales-leadership-hiring): store managers through area, regional and national sales heads
- [Finance and CFO search](https://boardroomcxo.com/finance-leadership-hiring): CFOs, finance heads, treasurers and financial controllers, including pre-IPO and cross-border mandates
- [HR and people leadership search](https://boardroomcxo.com/hr-leadership-hiring): CHROs, heads of talent acquisition, people operations and learning leaders

## UAE

- [Executive search for UAE consulting and business-setup firms](https://boardroomcxo.com/uae-consulting-hiring): marketing, business development and engineering leaders for UAE consulting, business-setup and corporate service firms, hired locally or sourced from India

## Hiring field notes

- [Solitario's Netflix Moment Exposes a Marketing Hiring Gap](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-solitario-cultural-relevance-marketing-leadership): why a Netflix brand integration that spiked Solitario Diamonds' traffic reveals most jewelry and D2C brands have hired the wrong kind of marketing leader: for paid reach, not cultural relevance
- [Aukera Raised ₹90 Cr: Inside India's Lab-Grown Diamond Race](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-aukera-lab-grown-diamond-category-race): what Aukera's back-to-back funding rounds and a legacy conglomerate's entry signal about the leadership talent lab-grown diamond jewellery brands need to scale
- [Why the Best Performance Marketers in Jewelry Are Not on Naukri](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-performance-marketer-jewelry): on the thin, non-job-hunting pool of marketers with real ROAS experience in the jewelry price range of ₹5,000–60,000
- [The Hidden Comp Gap: Why Jewelry Brands Keep Losing Candidates at the Offer Stage](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-hidden-comp-gap): field data on the gap between documented CTC and actual take-home pay at legacy jewelry/retail brands

## Inside the Boardroom: leadership profiles

- [Puneet Chhatwal: He Grew the Taj by Owning Less of It](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-puneet-chhatwal-ihcl-taj): how Puneet Chhatwal took over Taj Hotels after seven straight years of losses, raised ₹4,000 crore mid-pandemic, signed hotels without owning them, and took IHCL's profit past ₹2,000 crore for the first time
- [Noel Tata: The Job He Didn't Get, and the One He Built Instead](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-noel-tata-trent-zudio): how Noel Tata, passed over for chairman of Tata Sons in 2011, went back to running Westside, built Zudio into 963 of Trent's 1,286 stores, and in 2024 became chairman of Tata Trusts
- [M P Ahammed: How a Coconut Trader Built India's Largest Jeweller](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-mp-ahammed-malabar-gold): how M P Ahammed sold dried coconut for 12 years, opened a single jewellery shop in Kozhikode in 1993, and grew by selling debentures to investors in the Gulf into Malabar Gold, now 445 stores in 14 countries
- [Gopal Vittal: He Let 40 Million Customers Leave Airtel on Purpose](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-gopal-vittal-airtel-arpu): how Gopal Vittal, after free mobile data cut Airtel's profit 76.5% in a year, let 40 million low-spending customers go and built the network for customers who would pay more
- [Anish Shah: The Outsider Who Fixed Mahindra's ₹5,200 Crore Problem](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-anish-shah-mahindra-turnaround): how Anish Shah, the first non-family MD at Mahindra in 75 years, took over after a 98% profit fall, hit the group's five-year RoE target in eighteen months, and took second place in Indian cars from Hyundai
- [Costs Were Rising Everywhere. Sameer Khetarpal Cut Domino's Prices Anyway.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sameer-khetarpal-dominos-india): how Sameer Khetarpal held Domino's India prices flat in 2022 while costs rose, built Domino's own delivery fleet, and saw profit jump 190% by the September 2025 quarter
- [He Ran India's Biggest Luggage Company. Then He Bought the Rival One-Tenth Its Size.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sudhir-jatia-safari-industries): how Sudhir Jatia resigned from VIP Industries in 2010, bought 56.55% of Safari Industries for ₹29 crore in 2011, and grew sales from ₹70 crore to over ₹2,047 crore and market share from 2% to 23%
- [Venu Nair Took the Job Nobody Wanted at Shoppers Stop. He Turned It Around in About a Year.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-venu-nair-shoppers-stop): how Venu Nair took the top job at Shoppers Stop in November 2020 with malls empty and revenue down 44%, cut ₹450 crore in costs, and turned the company net-cash within about a year
- [Verghese Kurien Packed His Bags to Leave Anand. He Stayed Fifty Years and Built Amul.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-verghese-kurien-amul-cooperative): how a 27-year-old engineer who planned to leave a government creamery in Anand the moment his bond ended instead spent fifty years building the farmer-owned co-operative that became Amul, backing the world's first buffalo milk spray dryer in 1955 and running the National Dairy Development Board for 33 years, with Amul now owned by 3.6 million farmers and crossing ₹1 lakh crore in brand turnover in 2025-26
- [Bharat Puri Heard About the Cadbury Worms From TV News. He Fixed It in Three Months.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-bharat-puri-cadbury-worm-crisis): how Cadbury India Managing Director Bharat Puri responded to the October 2003 Dairy Milk worm contamination crisis by having his sales team verify the product, rebuilding the packaging into a sealed double wrap by January 2004 at Cadbury's own cost, and facing the media himself rather than relying on the FDA's clean chit for its factories, with sales back within six months
- [Everyone Said Royal Enfield Was Finished. Siddhartha Lal Asked for Two Years.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-siddhartha-lal-royal-enfield): how a 26-year-old Siddhartha Lal took charge of a dying Royal Enfield in 2000, spent four years fixing the product before touching the market, then deliberately shrank Eicher Motors from 15 businesses to two, a bet that took Royal Enfield past ten lakh motorcycles sold in FY25
- [C K Venkataraman: How Tanishq Fixed a Decade of Being Wrong About India](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-ck-venkataraman-tanishq-jewelry): how Tanishq spent its first decade guessing wrong about the Indian gold buyer, and how C K Venkataraman, jewellery CEO from 2005 to 2019 and later Titan's managing director, helped turn that lesson into India's biggest jewellery business, over ₹46,000 crore in FY25
- [Sunil D'Souza Turned Down Tata's FMCG Job, Then Built It From Tea and Salt](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sunil-dsouza-tata-consumer-products): why Sunil D'Souza initially declined the Tata Consumer Products role over its lack of direction, then took it once he understood the ambiguity was a build mandate, and grew the business to ₹20,290 crore in revenue
- [Ramesh Chauhan Sold Thums Up to Build Bisleri From Scratch](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-ramesh-chauhan-bisleri-thums-up): how Ramesh Chauhan sold India's dominant cola brand to Coca-Cola in 1993 and redeployed the capital into solving bottled water's distribution economics, building Bisleri into a category the brand name is now used generically to describe
- [Suresh Narayanan: The MD Who Walked Into the Maggi Ban](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-suresh-narayanan-maggi-crisis): how Suresh Narayanan took the Nestlé India MD role the same year 38,000 tonnes of Maggi were destroyed, and rebuilt the business to ₹20,000 crore
- [Sudhir Sitapati: Why He Left HUL's Safest Seat for Godrej](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sudhir-sitapati-godrej-leadership): why Sudhir Sitapati left Hindustan Unilever's management committee for the smaller Godrej Consumer Products, and what his tenure there, which ended with his resignation in August 2026, reveals about testing leadership judgment without institutional scaffolding
- [Shailesh Jejurikar: P&G's First Indian-Origin CEO in 187 Years](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-shailesh-jejurikar-pg-leadership): how a 36-year, single-employer career that ran through hard postings in East Africa and Asia culminated in Shailesh Jejurikar becoming the first Indian-origin CEO in Procter & Gamble's 187-year history
- [Sanjiv Mehta: The HUL Leader Who Never Forgot Bhopal](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sanjiv-mehta-crisis-leadership): how Sanjiv Mehta grew Hindustan Unilever's value more than 4x, closed the GSK Consumer merger, and doubled women in leadership, shaped by lessons from the Bhopal gas tragedy
- [Refused to Blink: The Boardroom Lesson Behind Marico's War With Hindustan Lever](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-marico-refused-to-blink): how Marico's founder rejected a 1999 buyout offer from Hindustan Lever and fought a four-front category war instead, a case study in founder-led leadership under existential pressure
